facts.fact: On 29 July 2026 the FCT High Court (suit CVI2190/25) ordered Stanbic IBTC Bank to pay N15 million in general damages and N500,000 costs to two former customers, to erase data it is not legally required to retain, and granted a perpetual injunction against further processing, finding violation of the Act, Section 37 of the Constitution and the Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act, 2018.
